text:
Fiona: Quick sync  were scheduling the "Serving at Scale" follow-up push (recording + gated deck). Need X thread, LI recap, and routing. Who owns what?

Omar: Ill draft the X thread + pin recording tweet. Short TL;DR + 3 takeaways. Will A/B test two hooks.

Leah: Ill do LinkedIn recap + carousel (4 cards). Need stat card + methodology link.

Jon: Ill build the HubSpot gate and routing. Fields: name, company, job_title, company_size, utm, interest_area. Routing rule?

Priya: Routing rule: if job_title contains (SRE|ML|Platform|Infra) OR company_size >=150 -> hot -> assign SDRs; else -> nurture. Also tag utm_source.

Omar: Thread plan: Tweet1 recording up + shortlink; Tweet2 stat card (internal benchmark qualifier); Tweet3 top Q + short answer; Tweet4 deck gate link + CTA.

Leah: Design asks: stat card 1200x675, hero 1200x628, 15s clip. Ill push frames to #design-handoff by EOD.

Jon: HubSpot form name: webinar_serving_followup_2026. Pseudo rule to copy into automation:
```
if job_title matches (SRE|ML|Platform|Infra) or company_size >=150:
  tag=hot
  assign=SDR_team
else:
  tag=nurture
  enroll=webinar_nurture_seq
```

Fiona: CTAs: 1) Watch recording 2) Download slides (gate) 3) Book 1:1 (top leads). Primary shortlink rwd.in/serve-record, backup rwd.in/serve.

Omar: Will post X at 09:30 PT, LinkedIn at 10:00 PT. Volunteers for live replies? Need 2.

Priya: SDRs will follow top 50 within 24h; top 200 get segmented email with recording. Jon will create saved list webinar_top50_followup_2026.

Leah: Legal ok with the phrasing "internal benchmark, results vary by workload" on stat card. Ill include the methodology link in the carousel final card.

ShortLink Bot: Created rwd.in/serve-record (primary) and rwd.in/serve (backup).

HubSpot Bot: Draft form webinar_serving_followup_2026 created -> https://app.hubspot.com/forms/12345/view/serve-follow (will publish when ready).

Fiona: Owners recap: Omar X + thread; Leah LI + carousel; Jon HubSpot + routing; Priya SDR ops; Fiona approvals. Drop :+1: if good or flag blockers.
